name: splice-refused-when-authored-rows-unrepresented
body:
When the win-C splice is selected and the assembled graph's durable-layer/transient rows (`apg/layers/**`, `.trans/plans/**`) are unrepresented in the seed, the splice is REFUSED and the existing FULL LOAD — the correctness reference — runs. The guard is an eligibility check rather than a partial write: the splice declines to patch authored/transient rows into the seeded DB.

Observable completion: seed a DB whose authored/transient rows differ from the assembled graph's; a scan publishes a DB equal to a full rebuild — it full-loads instead. This extends the existing content-identity seed guard (`rust.apg.splice.seed.seed_checked`), which equates the code content identity (`rust.apg.splice.seed.seed_key_matches`) and therefore admits a seed whose authored rows are stale.
